text: Databases store and organise information so we can find it quickly. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases use tables with rows and columns, like a spreadsheet. NoSQL databases store data in other ways, such as documents, and are more flexible. To get information from a database, we write queries, which are special commands. Good data modeling helps us plan how data connects before we build anything. Indexes make searches much faster, especially in large tables. Choosing the right database depends on your needs, so it is useful to understand these basic ideas.
